cap: Each genital structure has a homolog in the other sex because both grow from the same primordium. DHT decides the fate of the genital tubercle, urogenital folds and labioscrotal swellings, and the urogenital sinus, gubernaculum and processus vaginalis have paired fates too. A defect in one primordium, such as urethral folds that fail to fuse in hypospadias, can be read in either sex.
